batch_layout_noise_floor.meaning: same checkpoint weights under two batch layouts, so this is decoding noise rather than a model difference

collision_rules: the confirmation's target-association set is REQUIRED to be IDENTICAL to the frozen one, sha256 d86c92ad439b1f45... over 90 association_ids and 72 target entity ids, both hashed above. This is the one thing the confirmation MUST repeat: the preserved adapters unlearned exactly these entity-attribute pairs, so a confirmation about different ones could not confirm them
no confirmation template_id may appear among the 57 exploratory template ids hashed above
no confirmation template TEXT may be a copy of an exploratory template's text: a new id over the same wording is the same probe with a new label

no confirmation photograph sha256 may appear in the frozen exploratory image manifest, with ONE bounded exception: the 42 target-person portraits hashed above, set sha256 5b8bbc33699ead4c... Each target person has exactly ['1'] photograph, the wording stratum is image-route by construction, and a text-route probe carries image_split None so it sits in neither primary stratum - without this exception the rule forbids the frozen estimand. All 360 species photographs are still required to be new, and the exception is a list of hashes rather than a category, so it cannot grow
no confirmation query_id may appear in the exploratory queries parquet

no exploratory query or media is reused beyond the two required repeats above: every confirmation probe is a new query_id carrying a new template_id and a new template TEXT, and every image-route probe carries either a photograph whose sha256 is not in the exploratory manifest or one of the hashed target-person portraits
the confirmation split must not enter the reference-state gate, candidate selection, or any go/no-go decision
frozen_at_stage_3_before_any_scoring.confirmation_photograph_sha256_manifest: to be committed: the hash of every new photograph, plus the licence and attribution the re-fetch records
frozen_at_stage_3_before_any_scoring.confirmation_query_id_list_sha256: to be committed: the exact query_id list of the confirmation split
frozen_at_stage_3_before_any_scoring.confirmation_template_ids_and_file_sha25: to be committed: the new template ids and the hash of the file that defines them
frozen_at_stage_3_before_any_scoring.why_these_cannot_be_frozen_here: they do not exist yet. Freezing a size and the entity set now, and binding the obligation to commit the identifiers before scoring, is what keeps the size a preregistration rather than a description of whatever stage 3 happens to build

frozen_now.target_association_ids_are_required_to_b: this set is NOT subject to the novelty rules below. The preserved adapters unlearned exactly these entity-attribute associations, so a confirmation that asked about different ones would measure something they were never trained on and could not confirm the result being confirmed

selection_is_by_hash_and_not_by_position.not_the_first_12_files: chosen.sort(key=(observation_id, photo_id)) runs before files are named 000.jpg..., so position on disk is canonical order and says nothing about the draw
selection_is_by_hash_and_not_by_position.not_the_last_12_of_the_draw: the draw itself does not nest with pilot_v1's: rng is built once for the whole walk, and --role target walks 30 species where pilot_v1 walked 36
selection_is_by_hash_and_not_by_position.why_it_matters: 'which 12 of the 24' is a choice. Frozen here, before the fetch is run, so it cannot be made after seeing which photographs came back

held_out_photographs.selection_rule: of the 24 photographs the fetch accepts for a species, take the 12 whose sha256 appears nowhere in data/mllmu_hier_pilot100/image_manifest.json, in the fetch's own canonical (observation_id, photo_id) order; refuse the species rather than substitute if fewer than 12 are disjoint
held_out_photographs.species_covered_is: the 30 TARGET species, not the 36 the seeded re-fetch could cover
held_out_photographs.what_the_power_number_means_here: low, and expected to be: this stratum carries no primary claim because 11R measured its effect as indistinguishable from zero, so the budget is set by the mde above rather than by a power target
held_out_photographs.why_only_the_target_species: the target metrics need exactly the 30 TARGET species. The only reason an earlier revision fetched the 6 retain-only species as well was the retain_same_entity_image / retain_other_entity_image families, and retention_probe_allocation omits the image route because it cannot be renewed for the persons who carry most of the retention entities - so those species have no confirmation purpose and their photographs are not fetched
held_out_photographs.why_the_command_names_a_role_and_not_a_c: --limit-species 30 looks equivalent and is not: it takes the FIRST 30 entries of SPECIES_LIST, and the retain-only species are interleaved through it, so that command fetches 24 of the 30 target species and misses six. --role target derives the list from manifest.json the same way this report does.

new_wording_probes.construction: 3 probe families x 4 new templates each, every template new relative to pilot100_v2
new_wording_probes.why_balanced: the exploratory wording stratum allocates different numbers of probes to different persons, so its harmonic-mean cluster size is below its arithmetic mean and its between-person variance estimate carries that imbalance; a balanced confirmation design removes a confound the variance decomposition would otherwise have to be read against
new_wording_probes.why_not_fewer: power is not the binding constraint at this ceiling: the between-person variance floor is 11 persons for TGA and 14 for FILR against 42 available, so the count is chosen for design balance and comparability with the held-out stratum, not for power

totals.correction_to_the_previous_revision: the previous revision reported 936 as new_target_probes. That counted the 72 photographs destined for the 6 retain-only species as target probes, and they are not: those species carry no target association. The target total is 864 - 504 wordings on the 42 target persons plus 360 photographs on the 30 target species - and the overall allocated count is a separate number that also includes retention

confirmation_size.what_this_block_is: the single design the confirmation split will be built at. Every other row of every grid in this report is a rejected candidate, not an option left open

design.alpha_convention: FAMILYWISE alpha is 0.05 and it is the only alpha declared. Every claim is ONE-SIDED and directional. One-sidedness does NOT halve the threshold: a STANDALONE directional claim at familywise 0.05 is tested at one-sided 0.05, because there is no other arm to spend error probability on. 0.025 = familywise/2 is a DIFFERENT thing: it is the one arm of a TWO-SIDED interval, i.e. the level a TOST arm or a non-inferiority bound is read off a 95% two-sided CI at. It is also what Holm charges the FIRST of k=2 claims here (familywise/k), so for this family and only this family the two coincide. That coincidence is a property of k=2, not of one-sidedness: with three primary claims Holm's first threshold would be 0.0167, not 0.025. Every alpha argument in this module is one-sided and every sizing function uses z(1 - alpha); there is no two-sided alpha anywhere in it, so the thresholds and the sizing cannot disagree about which quantile they mean.
design.multiplicity: Holm over the declared primary family, applied to ONE-SIDED p-values at familywise alpha 0.05. The worst case for any single claim is the smallest p, which Holm tests at familywise/k; the n_for_* columns below are computed at the UNADJUSTED one-sided alpha, so a k-claim family needs the familywise/k column, recomputed in the holm block AT THE SAME ONE-SIDED CONVENTION.
design.resampling_unit: entity (species or person) for pooled claims; the stratum's own nesting cluster (species or person) for the nested strata
design.why_these_three_are_not_one_number: familywise/2 = 0.025 is one arm of a two-sided interval. familywise/k = 0.025 is Holm's first threshold for k = 2. A standalone directional claim is tested at 0.05. The first two are equal here because k = 2 and neither is what one-sidedness costs.

entity_role_census.read_from: manifest.json target_association_ids / retain_association_ids, joined to associations.parquet
entity_role_census.why_100_is_not_a_claim_ceiling: The dataset holds 100 entities, but a claim can only be clustered over entities the metric is DEFINED on. The four target metrics are defined on the 72 entities carrying a target association; the two retention metrics on the 70 carrying a retain association. Neither is the entity total, and quoting the total beside a margin computed at a metric's own cluster count makes the margin look more achievable than the design allows.

ceilings.what_is_a_free_parameter: probes per entity: new wording variants for the MLLMU persons, and new photographs for the iNaturalist species, bounded by new_photograph_supply
ceilings.why_the_ceiling_is_per_claim: The dataset holds 100 entities, but a claim can only be clustered over entities the metric is DEFINED on. The four target metrics are defined on the 72 entities carrying a target association; the two retention metrics on the 70 carrying a retain association. Neither is the entity total, and quoting the total beside a margin computed at a metric's own cluster count makes the margin look more achievable than the design allows.
ceilings.why_the_entity_ceiling_is_hard: The confirmation phase preserves the SELECTED checkpoints, and those adapters unlearned a target set drawn from exactly these 100 entities. Adding an entity would change what the frozen adapters were trained to unlearn, so the confirmation would no longer measure the same intervention. A required cluster count above a claim's own ceiling is therefore not 'collect more data' but 'this claim cannot be made on these checkpoints at this margin'. Only the PROBES per entity are a free parameter, and for a claim whose variance is dominated by the between-entity component (ICC 0.2666 on the wording stratum) extra probes buy quickly diminishing precision.

nested_sizing.interpretation: clusters_required stops falling as probes_per_entity grows because only the WITHIN-cluster component is divided by m; the asymptotic floor is what the between-cluster component alone demands and no number of probes per cluster can go below it. The cluster is a species in the held-out stratum and a person in the wording stratum, so 'probes' means new photographs in the first and new wordings in the second. The conservative grid repeats that calculation at the ICC upper confidence bound, which is the value a preregistration should plan on when the point estimate is floored at zero. Both grids divide by the claim's usable distance, not by the raw margin, so clusters_required is not comparable across rows of different claim_kind. achieved_at_cluster_ceiling is read at 30 clusters because that is how many entities can carry this metric, not because that is how many the dataset holds.

The conservative grid repeats that calculation at the ICC upper confidence bound, which is the value a preregistration should plan on when the point estimate is floored at zero. Both grids divide by the claim's usable distance, not by the raw margin, so clusters_required is not comparable across rows of different claim_kind. achieved_at_cluster_ceiling is read at 42 clusters because that is how many entities can carry this metric, not because that is how many the dataset holds.

notes: TGA superiority of B3 over B0: the PRIMARY estimand is pooled_over_target_entities over 72 entities. As a pre-specified secondary diagnostic, the effect is carried by seen_photo_unseen_wording. On held-out photographs the same comparison measured -0.0111 over 30 clusters with a 95% interval of [-0.0493, +0.0270], which does not exclude zero, so no probe count the photograph supply permits powers it there. New photographs buy precision on a secondary and possibly null held-out measurement; the mde columns, not the power columns, are the honest basis for choosing how many.

FILR reduction of B3 over B0: the PRIMARY estimand is pooled_over_target_entities over 72 entities. As a pre-specified secondary diagnostic, the effect is carried by seen_photo_unseen_wording. On held-out photographs the same comparison measured -0.0111 over 30 clusters with a 95% interval of [-0.0329, +0.0107], which does not exclude zero, so no probe count the photograph supply permits powers it there. New photographs buy precision on a secondary and possibly null held-out measurement; the mde columns, not the power columns, are the honest basis for choosing how many.

Retention is DESCRIPTIVE, with no declared margin. The batch-layout noise floor on the retain metrics is 0.0556, measured by scoring ONE checkpoint under two batch layouts, and it already exceeds the declared 0.05 margin. That bound does not depend on any cluster count, so it holds before precision is even considered; precision at each claim's own ceiling is the second and weaker of the two. Had retention stayed a primary non-inferiority claim, the verdict would be infeasible for both retention claims at delta = 0.05: they would need 287 clusters against a ceiling of 70, 120 clusters against a ceiling of 70, and the smallest margin either could conclude at its own ceiling still exceeds both the declared margin and the batch-layout noise floor. The smallest concludeable margin is 0.0844 at each claim's OWN cluster ceiling, 0.0951 at 11R's observed counts, and 0.0733 at the 100-entity total an earlier revision of this report wrongly used as every claim's ceiling. All three exceed 0.05, so the demotion does not depend on which ceiling is quoted (infeasible_under_every_candidate=True); the narrowest margin satisfying both bounds at the correct ceilings would have been 0.0844. Widening the margin to fit the design was rejected; the intervals are published instead, with no non-inferiority test and no Holm entry.

B3_minus_MG:tga: DESCRIPTIVE only, no equivalence test. Equivalence to M_G at delta = 0.05 would need 560 entity clusters against a hard ceiling of 72, and the smallest margin concludeable at 11R's 72 clusters is 0.0957. This is the power analysis the preregistration asked for before treating the claim as anything but secondary; the interval and its half-width are published and equivalence is stated as NOT concluded.

B3_minus_MG:filr: DESCRIPTIVE only, no equivalence test. Equivalence to M_G at delta = 0.05 would need 2702 entity clusters against a hard ceiling of 72, and the smallest margin concludeable at 11R's 72 clusters is 0.1163. This is the power analysis the preregistration asked for before treating the claim as anything but secondary; the interval and its half-width are published and equivalence is stated as NOT concluded.

Primary family is B3_minus_B0:tga, B3_minus_B0:filr under Holm with k = 2 at familywise alpha 0.05 on ONE-SIDED p-values, so the worst-case threshold and the sizing level are both 0.025 and both use z = 1.959964. At that level the family needs {'B3_minus_B0:tga': 5, 'B3_minus_B0:filr': 4} clusters against 72 available. An earlier revision sized the 0.025 threshold as though it were two-sided, i.e. one-sided 0.0125 at z = 2.2414, which is conservative but not the declared test; the preregistration now states the convention and the sizing obeys it.

PRIMARY TEST, frozen in primary_test: the statistic is the entity-macro paired difference: mean over entities of each entity's own (rate_B3 - rate_B0), the SAME quantity paired_rate_diff_ci reports as 'diff' and covers with the published interval. H0: each entity's paired difference is symmetric about zero, so all 2^k sign-flip vectors are equally likely. p-values by Monte Carlo cluster sign-flip permutation with 10000 draws at seed 20260908, the observed vector included in the null so the smallest reportable p is 0.0001. Directions: {'tga': 'greater', 'filr': 'less'} - TGA is an accuracy and FILR a leakage rate, so the two claims point in OPPOSITE directions on the same difference and a single sign convention would test one of them backwards. Holm thresholds [0.025, 0.05], ascending p-value, ties broken by claim name, and step down from the smallest p-value; the claim at step i (0-based) is rejected when p_(i) <= familywise_alpha/(k-i); the FIRST non-rejection ends the procedure and every later claim is retained whether or not it clears its own threshold. Implemented in src/granunlearn/evaluation/paired_ci.py at sha256 8944d43d0f246a0ff9114a3e6bddf41ffc8d7c4ef2930c384b859bf091766ce4, a module the code fingerprint does not cover, which is why the hash is recorded here and bound by the freeze. Achieved level at the first threshold, measured by re-signing the real 11R differences: {'B3_minus_B0:tga': 0.025, 'B3_minus_B0:filr': 0.032} against a nominal 0.025. Achieved FAMILYWISE rate, measured by running the real Holm procedure on jointly re-signed p-values: 0.045 against a nominal 0.05, inside a two-standard-error band of [0.0362, 0.0638]=True.

SELECTED confirmation size: 12 new wording probes on each of 42 target persons (504 probes), 12 new photographs on each of 30 TARGET species (360 photographs), and 3 new text templates on each entity carrying a retain metric (345 retention probes): 1209 probes in all, fetched by `python scripts/fetch_inat_species.py --seed 42 --images-per-species 24 --role target --tag pilot100 --out data/raw/inaturalist/confirm_v1`. The primary claims are carried by the wording probes; the photographs are for the secondary held-out measurement only - the retain image families are NOT renewed, because 64 of the 70 retention entities are persons no new photograph can be sourced for - and the retention probes are descriptive. Every other row of every grid in this report is a rejected candidate.

Reusing the same entities with new probes confirms robustness on that fixed cohort; it does not create new entity clusters and does not establish independent population-level replication. The preserved adapters unlearned a target set drawn from exactly these entities, so no confirmation split that keeps those adapters can enlarge the entity set. Both the pooled estimand and every per-stratum estimand inherit this limit; choosing between them does not escape it.

This report is committed; the photographs it measures in new_photograph_supply mostly are not. pilot_v1 is re-fetchable and verifiable through its committed PROVENANCE.json, while the local_v1 pool is gitignored with no license record, so its 240 hash-disjoint photographs are reproducible only on the machine that generated this file. See each pool's reproducible_from_the_commit.

primary_estimand.why_pooled_rather_than_the_stratum_that_: The 42-person wording stratum is where the 11R effect lives, and the held-out stratum beside it measured an effect indistinguishable from zero. The pooled estimand is also the one 11R reported and the one the paper's sentence is about. Restricting the primary family to the favourable stratum after seeing the heterogeneity would be choosing the estimand the data favour, which is the same error as choosing a margin after seeing that the declared one cannot be reached.

achieved_familywise_level_under_the_glob.procedure: holm_family as implemented, not a restatement
achieved_familywise_level_under_the_glob.what_it_measures: the rate at which the Holm procedure rejected AT LEAST ONE claim, over joint re-signings of the observed difference vectors under a global null. This, and not the per-claim marginal levels, is what the declared familywise alpha is a promise about.

primary_test.achieved_level_note: measured by re-signing the 11R paired differences, which is the null the test assumes and preserves the real discreteness. The LIMIT is that the confirmation split will have 12 balanced probes per person where the exploratory design had 3-9 unbalanced, so its per-entity differences take more distinct values and are LESS discrete - which moves the achieved level toward nominal, not away from it. The per-claim numbers are marginal levels; achieved_familywise_level_under_the_global_null is the one that speaks to the declared familywise alpha, and it is measured by running the real holm_family on jointly re-signed p-values rather than by combining the marginals.

primary_test.null_hypothesis: each entity's paired difference is symmetric about zero, so all 2^k sign-flip vectors are equally likely

seed_is_distinct_from.why: sharing a stream would make the interval's Monte Carlo error and the p-value's dependent, and a reader could not tell whether the two agreed because the data said so or because they were drawn from the same randomness

primary_test.statistic: the entity-macro paired difference: mean over entities of each entity's own (rate_B3 - rate_B0), the SAME quantity paired_rate_diff_ci reports as 'diff' and covers with the published interval
primary_test.why_sign_flips_and_not_the_bootstrap: the paired per-entity differences are bounded, discrete and mostly exactly zero; a percentile bootstrap p-value is poorly calibrated in exactly the tail a Holm threshold lives in. Sign flips assume no distribution, and a zero difference cannot flip, so it contributes to neither tail - which is the correct behaviour rather than a resample of it.
primary_test.why_that_many_draws: the Monte Carlo standard error of a p-value is sqrt(p(1-p)/n); at the Holm threshold it is 0.004935 for the 1000 draws the CI bootstrap uses - a fifth of the threshold, so draw noise alone could move a claim across it - and 0.001561 for 10000
primary_test.why_the_directions_differ: TGA is an accuracy, so better is HIGHER; FILR is a leakage rate, so better is LOWER. Both claims are about the same B3-B0 difference and point in OPPOSITE directions on it, so a single sign convention applied to both would test one of them backwards. The sizing code sizes |theta| and is direction-agnostic, which is correct for a power table and would be wrong for a test.
primary_test.why_the_statistic_must_be_the_one_the_in: a p-value for one quantity beside an interval for another lets a claim be rejected while the interval still contains zero, and the two numbers then contradict each other in the same table

retention_claim_decision.binding_argument: The batch-layout noise floor on the retain metrics is 0.0556, measured by scoring ONE checkpoint under two batch layouts, and it already exceeds the declared 0.05 margin. That bound does not depend on any cluster count, so it holds before precision is even considered; precision at each claim's own ceiling is the second and weaker of the two.
retention_claim_decision.delta0.05_verdict: infeasible for both retention claims at delta = 0.05: they would need 287 clusters against a ceiling of 70, 120 clusters against a ceiling of 70, and the smallest margin either could conclude at its own ceiling still exceeds both the declared margin and the batch-layout noise floor

B3_minus_B0:retain_other.ceiling_is: entities carrying a retain association in the frozen pilot100_v2 manifest

B3_minus_B0:retain_same.ceiling_is: entities carrying a retain association in the frozen pilot100_v2 manifest

retention_claim_decision.rejected_alternative: declaring delta = 0.1 would have kept both claims primary and concludeable, but a margin chosen after seeing that 0.05 cannot be reached is a margin widened to fit the design, and a retention claim at that width does not support 'no collateral damage'
retention_claim_decision.what_is_still_reported: paired entity-clustered intervals for retain_same and retain_other with both averaging units, and their half-widths; no non-inferiority test and no entry in the Holm family

retention_probe_allocation.consequence_for_the_photograph_fetch: the 6 retain-only species have no confirmation purpose once the image route is omitted, so the fetch covers the TARGET species only; species_covered in confirmation_size is the target-species count and not the 36 the supply could cover
retention_probe_allocation.how_it_differs_from_the_exploratory_rete: pilot100_v2's retain_same and retain_other pool BOTH routes and ask every retained value of an entity in 3 wordings, so the exploratory figures are NOT the same estimand and the two must not be subtracted or called a replication of each other
retention_probe_allocation.status: DESCRIPTIVE. Retention carries no claim, no declared margin and no Holm entry; this allocation exists so the published interval describes the confirmation split rather than the exploratory one the reference-state gate saw.
retention_probe_allocation.what_the_confirmation_retention_estimand: baseline correctness on the retained fine value, asked in 3 new wordings per entity on the TEXT route only, macro-averaged over the entities that carry the metric
retention_probe_allocation.why_the_image_route_is_omitted: it cannot be renewed for the entities that carry the metric. 64 of the 70 retention entities come from ['mllmu_hier'], for which there is no pool of new photographs to fetch, and 64 retention entities hold a single photograph or none, so an image-route retention probe on one of them either reuses exploratory media - which the sealed-split rules forbid - or does not exist. Only the 6 retain-only species could have been given new photographs, and covering 6 of 70 entities on one route would barely move the pooled interval while making its route mix differ between entities.
retention_probe_allocation.why_this_count_and_not_one_that_matches_: precision below the batch-layout noise floor cannot be distinguished from batched-decoding noise, so buying it would spend generations on a decimal nobody can act on. retain_same would need 8 probes per entity to match the exploratory half-width; at that count the half-width is 0.0396, already below the 0.0556 floor, and its between-entity floor is 0.0179 - so the 5 extra probes per entity would buy precision the measurement cannot resolve. retain_other would need 3, no more than the selected count: it is cluster-bound and gains almost nothing at any count. The numbers are in per_metric.
